title: Source-first hero synopsis
summary: This iteration promotes the source signal story into the daily report hero so the first viewport carries both the reader-facing story line and source signal metrics. The implementation keeps the expanded `source-signal-story`, source dashboard, status focus, map, fixed-order inventory, finder, and all 154 source rows intact.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "source-first IA dashboard|source signal story rollup|source-first hero synopsis" tests/unit.test.js
Independent subagent verification: npm run test:e2e plus DOM checks for hero source synopsis, privacy leakage, and 154 source rows

Playwright visual check: desktop 1280x900 and mobile 390x844 on docs/reports/2026/06/2026-06-29.html; screenshots .tmp/phase13-source-first-hero-synopsis-desktop.png and .tmp/phase13-source-first-hero-synopsis-mobile.png

lessons.lesson: The first viewport can express source-first IA without changing the renderer by shaping the existing daily hero summary into a two-line synopsis.
lessons.evidence: `reportToInteractionInput()` now returns a bullet-form hero summary containing the story line and source signal line, and E2E verifies the summary appears before navigation.
lessons.recommended_action: Prefer deterministic interaction-input shaping for first-viewport source improvements before modifying the shared effective-interact renderer.

lessons.lesson: Hero summaries with semicolon-heavy source metrics must be explicit bullet lines, otherwise the renderer's long-summary splitter can truncate later counts.
lessons.evidence: Initial E2E failed because the source signal sentence was split and capped; the final implementation prefixes the story and source lines with bullets so the renderer preserves the full source count line.
lessons.recommended_action: When adding structured synopsis text to `input.summary`, use explicit bullet lines if any line includes multiple metric clauses.

lessons.lesson: First-viewport source visibility still needs the detailed proof surfaces immediately below the hero.
lessons.evidence: Visual checks confirmed the hero synopsis and metrics fit in desktop/mobile first viewports while the expanded source story and dashboard remain first in the section stack.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep the hero as the compact lead and the `source-signal-story`/dashboard/inventory surfaces as the audit trail.

followups.action: Convert the fixed source importance proposal into a maintainer-facing source insertion handbook so future sources can be placed consistently without dynamic re-ranking.
